name: myco
description: Your project's memory: the sessions that happened, the durable observations drawn from them, and the plans. Skills and tools for reading why the code is the way it is, and for recording what you learn.

variables.name: DEPLOYMENT_URL
variables.description: The base URL of your team's Myco deployment, for example https://myco.example.com

variables.name: ACCESS_KEY
variables.description: A project access key from your deployment dashboard. It reaches one project and expires.
